# CoNLL-U

> Header-only C++23 library for reading, editing, and writing treebanks in the [CoNLL-U](https://universaldependencies.org/format.html) format of Universal Dependencies, including [CoNLL-U Plus](https://universaldependencies.org/ext-format.html) files with custom columns. Parse a file, string, byte buffer, stream, or arbitrary chunks of input into an in-memory `Treebank`; modify sentences, tokens, multiword tokens, and empty nodes; write it back out. Everything is in namespace `tg::conllu`, errors are reported as `std::error_code` (no exceptions), and almost every function is `noexcept`.

- Source: https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U
- Homepage and API reference: https://conll-u.tugrulgungor.me
- License: MIT. Author: Tuğrul Güngör.
- Requires C++23 (`<expected>`, `std::format`, ranges). Builds with GCC, Clang, and MSVC.

## Getting it

The library is header-only; there is nothing to build or link.

- **CMake, installed:** `cmake --install <build-dir> --prefix <prefix>`, then in your project `find_package(CoNLL-U REQUIRED)` and `target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE tg::conllu::CoNLL-U)`. Versions before 1.0 are only compatible within the same minor version (`find_package(CoNLL-U 0.1)`).
- **CMake, vendored:** `add_subdirectory(CoNLL-U)` and link the same `tg::conllu::CoNLL-U` target. The library's `BUILD_TESTS`, `BUILD_DOCS`, and `BUILD_DEMO` options are ignored when it is not the top-level project.
- **Single header:** download the `conllu.hpp` attached to each GitHub release.
- **Manually:** add `include/` to the include path and compile as C++23.

Then `#include <conllu.hpp>`.

## Quick start

```cpp
#include <conllu.hpp>
#include <print>

using namespace tg;

auto parsed = conllu::Parser{}.parse_file("en_ewt-ud-test.conllu");
if (!parsed) {
    std::println(stderr, "parse failed: {}", parsed.error().message());
    return 1;
}
std::unique_ptr<conllu::Treebank> treebank = std::move(*parsed);

for (const conllu::Sentence* sentence : treebank->sentences()) {
    std::println("{}: {}", sentence->get_sent_id(), sentence->get_text());

    for (const conllu::Token* token : sentence->tokens()) {
        const auto form = token->get_field_value("FORM").value_or("_");
        const auto deprel = token->get_field_value("DEPREL").value_or("_");
        if (const auto head = token->get_head())
            std::println("  {} --{}--> {}", form, deprel, (*head)->get_field_value("FORM").value_or("_"));
        else
            std::println("  {} ({})", form, deprel);
    }
}

if (const std::error_code err = conllu::Writer{}.write_file(treebank.get(), "out.conllu"))
    std::println(stderr, "write failed: {}", err.message());
```

## Data model

```
Treebank                          columns (ordered names) + documents
└── Document                      `# newdoc` (optional `id = …`) + document comments
    └── Paragraph                 `# newpar` (optional `id = …`)
        └── Sentence              sent_id, text, metadata (# comment lines, in file order)
            ├── empty nodes 0.1…  sentence-level empty nodes, before the first token
            ├── Token 1, 2, 3, …  one field per column; HEAD resolves to another Token
            │   └── empty nodes N.1…  empty nodes attached after token N
            └── Word 1-2, 3-4, …  multiword tokens: a range of 2+ tokens with one surface form
```

- Every sentence belongs to exactly one paragraph of one document. `Treebank::sentences()` is still a flat view over all of them, and `Treebank::add_sentence()` appends to the last paragraph of the last document.
- A document or paragraph is **explicit** when the file marks it (`# newdoc` / `# newpar`, with or without an id) and **implicit** otherwise. Only the first document (sentences before the first `# newdoc`) and the first paragraph of each document (sentences before its first `# newpar`) can be implicit, and the writer emits no marker for them. Everything created with `add_document()` / `add_paragraph()` or by `split()` is explicit.
- **Document comments** are the lines between `# newdoc` and a following `# newpar` (e.g. GUM's `# meta::…`); without a `# newpar` after it, the lines after `# newdoc` belong to the sentence. The writer adds bare markers when a document with comments would otherwise not read back the same.
- `newdoc`, `newpar` (with or without ` id`) are not sentence comments: `Sentence::set_metadata()` returns `ReservedMetaKey`. Use `Document::set_id()` / `Paragraph::set_id()`.
- Restructure with `split(sentence)` (the sentence starts a new document or paragraph) and `merge_next()`; sentences keep their address, tokens, and comments. Empty documents and paragraphs are allowed and skipped by the writer. The spec doesn't say whether a paragraph may span two documents; here it never does. Mid-sentence paragraph breaks (`NewPar=Yes` in MISC) are not considered.

- Everything is owned by its parent and created through it: `Treebank::add_document`, `Document::add_paragraph`, `Paragraph::add_sentence` (or `Treebank::add_sentence`), `Sentence::add_token`, `Sentence::add_word`, `Sentence::add_empty_node`, `Token::add_empty_node`. The API hands out raw, non-owning pointers.
- A `Treebank` cannot be copied or moved; keep it in the `std::unique_ptr` that parsing returns, or create one with `std::make_unique<conllu::Treebank>()`.
- Collections (`documents()`, `paragraphs()`, `sentences()`, `tokens()`, `words()`, `empty_nodes()`, `fields()`, `metadata()`) are lazy views. Don't keep a view, or a pointer obtained from one, across a call that removes elements.

## Rules the library enforces

- **Columns.** Without a leading `# global.columns = …` line, a treebank gets the 10 standard columns (`ID FORM LEMMA UPOS XPOS FEATS HEAD DEPREL DEPS MISC`). Column names are uppercase ASCII letters with at most one inner `:` (e.g. `PARSEME:MWE`). Any set of columns works, but `ID`, `FORM`, `HEAD`, `MISC`, and `FEATS` have special meaning when present.
- **Sentences.** Every sentence needs a `# sent_id = …` line. The ID must be non-empty, contain no spaces, tabs, line breaks, or `/`, and be unique in the treebank.
- **Token IDs** are 1-based and consecutive. They are assigned by `add_token()` and renumbered by `remove_token()`; the `ID` field can't be set directly (`ImmutableTokenField`).
- **HEAD** is `0` (root) or the ID of a token in the same sentence, and never the token itself. Set it with `Token::set_head(id)`; setting the `HEAD` field goes through the same check. `get_head()` returns `std::nullopt` for the root and for an unset HEAD.
- **Empty nodes** (`N.M`) come right after token `N`, numbered from 1 with no gaps; sentence-level ones (`0.M`) come before the first token and before any multiword token line. Their HEAD must be `_`; their relations live in `DEPS`. Empty nodes can't have empty nodes of their own.
- **Multiword tokens** (`first-last`) span at least two tokens, appear before their first token, and must not overlap. Apart from the range they may only carry `FORM`, `MISC`, and `FEATS` = `Typo=Yes`.
- Parsing validates every sentence. `validate()` on a `Treebank`, `Sentence`, `Token`, or `Word` checks structures you have built or edited by hand.

## Behavior worth knowing

- **`_` means unset.** On input, a field that is exactly `_` becomes `std::nullopt` (`get_field_value` returns `std::nullopt`), and unset fields are written back as `_`. `ParserOptions` and `WriterOptions` let you change this character via `empty_value_indicator`.
- **Streams are passed by rvalue reference** (`Parser::parse(std::istream&&)`, `Writer::write(const Treebank*, std::ostream&&)`). Pass a temporary (`std::ofstream("out.conllu")`) or `std::move` an existing stream; it is only written to, not moved from: `conllu::Writer{}.write(tb.get(), std::move(std::cout))`.
- **`sent_id` and `text` are also metadata entries.** They appear in `metadata()` and `get_metadata("text")`; change them with `set_sent_id()` and `set_text()`. `set_metadata()` only adds new keys and returns `DuplicateSentenceMetaEntry` for an existing one.
- **Comments keep their order.** `metadata()` lists a sentence's `#` lines in file order and the writer writes them back in that order; `set_metadata()` appends. A bare `# key` line has an empty value and is written back bare, and comments before a `# newdoc` / `# newpar` line stay before it. Spaces around a comment's `=` are not preserved (`#  key  =  value` reads as key `key`, value `value`).
- **The writer always emits a `# global.columns = …` header**, even for the standard columns. That makes its output CoNLL-U Plus, and it reads back as the same column set.
- **Input tolerance.** `\n` and `\r\n` line endings, repeated blank lines between sentences, and a missing final newline are all accepted.
- **`remove_token(id)` refuses** (`InvalidTokenHead`) if another token's HEAD points at it, unless `skip_dependency_validation = true`, which clears those heads. Later tokens, their HEADs, their empty nodes, and the ranges of multiword tokens are renumbered; a multiword token left with fewer than two tokens is removed.

## Streaming

`StreamParser` builds a treebank from input you feed in chunks of any size — useful for sockets, decompressors, or a browser/WASM bridge. `Parser` is a thin wrapper around it.

```cpp
conllu::StreamParser parser;  // or conllu::StreamParser{conllu::ParserOptions{...}}

char buffer[4096];
while (source.read(buffer, sizeof buffer) || source.gcount() > 0) {
    if (const std::error_code err = parser.feed({buffer, static_cast<std::size_t>(source.gcount())})) {
        std::println(stderr, "{} (sentence starting at line {})", err.message(), parser.error_line());
        return 1;
    }
    // parser.treebank() already holds every sentence completed so far.
}

auto result = parser.finish();  // parses a final sentence that has no trailing blank line
```

- Chunks may split lines (and `\r\n`) anywhere; the chunk's memory is not kept after `feed` returns.
- A sentence is added as soon as the blank line that ends it has been fed. `treebank()` only ever contains complete sentences: one that fails halfway is rolled back.
- The first error is sticky: every later `feed()` and `finish()` returns it. `error()` and `error_line()` (1-based, the first line of the failing sentence) describe it, the partial result stays in `treebank()`, and `reset()` clears everything.
- After a successful `finish()` the parser is reset and can be reused for another input.

## Building a treebank

```cpp
auto treebank = std::make_unique<conllu::Treebank>();
for (const std::string_view column :
     {"ID", "FORM", "LEMMA", "UPOS", "XPOS", "FEATS", "HEAD", "DEPREL", "DEPS", "MISC"})
    treebank->add_column(column).value();  // columns first: tokens get one field per column

conllu::Sentence* sentence = treebank->add_sentence("s1", "Hello world").value();

conllu::Token* hello = sentence->add_token().value();  // ID 1 (IDs are assigned, never set)
conllu::Token* world = sentence->add_token().value();  // ID 2

(void)hello->set_field_value("FORM", "Hello");
(void)hello->set_head(0);  // 0 = root
(void)hello->set_field_value("DEPREL", "root");

(void)world->set_field_value("FORM", "world");
(void)world->set_head(hello->get_id());
(void)world->set_field_value("DEPREL", "vocative");

if (const std::error_code err = treebank->validate())
    std::println(stderr, "invalid: {}", err.message());

(void)conllu::Writer{}.write(treebank.get(), std::move(std::cout));
```

Add the columns before adding tokens: a token gets one field per column that exists at the time, and `add_column()` later extends every existing token and empty node with an unset field.

## Errors

Functions that can fail return `std::error_code` (empty on success) or `std::expected<T, std::error_code>`. `conllu::ErrorCode` is registered as an error-code enum, so you can compare directly and get a readable message:

```cpp
auto result = conllu::Parser{}.parse_memory("# sent_id = s1\n1\tA\t_\n");
if (!result && result.error() == conllu::ErrorCode::TokenFieldCountMismatch)
    std::println("{}", result.error().message());  // "token field count mismatch"
```

The codes, by area:

- I/O and resources: `StreamError`, `InsufficientMemory`, `InvalidPointer`, `PositionOutOfRange`
- Columns: `InvalidColumnsLine`, `InvalidColumnName`, `DuplicateColumnName`, `ColumnNotFound`
- Sentences and metadata: `SentenceMustStartWithMetaLine`, `InvalidSentenceMetaLine`, `InvalidSentenceMetaKey`, `DuplicateSentenceMetaEntry`, `MissingSentenceId`, `InvalidSentenceId`, `DuplicateSentenceId`, `SentenceIdCannotBeRemoved`, `SentenceNotFoundInTreebank`
- Tokens and empty nodes: `InvalidTokenId`, `TokenFieldCountMismatch`, `ImmutableTokenField`, `TokenEmptyNodeMismatch`, `NodeNotFoundInToken`, `InvalidTokenHead`, `TokenNotFoundInSentence`, `InvalidNumberOfFields`
- Multiword tokens: `InvalidWordRange`, `OverlappingWordRange`, `WordNotFoundInSentence`, `WordMustAppearBeforeToken`, `InvalidWordFieldValue`

## Headers

- [conllu.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu.hpp): Umbrella header; includes everything below.
- [conllu/parser.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/parser.hpp): `Parser`, which parses complete input: `parse(std::istream&&)`, `parse_file(path)`, `parse_memory(std::string_view)`, and `parse_memory(const T* bytes, size)` for any 1-byte `T`. Each returns `std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Treebank>, std::error_code>`.
- [conllu/stream_parser.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/stream_parser.hpp): `ParserOptions` and `StreamParser`: `feed(chunk)`, `finish()`, `reset()`, `treebank()`, `num_lines()`, `error()`, `error_line()`.
- [conllu/writer.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/writer.hpp): `WriterOptions` and `Writer`: `write(treebank, std::ostream&&)` and `write_file(treebank, path)`.
- [conllu/treebank.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/treebank.hpp): `Treebank`. Columns: `columns()`, `num_columns()`, `get_column_pos(name)`, `get_column_name(pos)`, `add_column(name)`. Documents: `documents()`, `num_documents()`, `add_document(id = std::nullopt)`, `remove_document(Document*)`. Sentences: `sentences()`, `num_sentences()`, `add_sentence(sent_id, text = {})`, `get_sentence_by_id(sent_id)`, `remove_sentence(sent_id | Sentence*)`. State: `empty()`, `clear()`, `validate()`.
- [conllu/sentence.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/sentence.hpp): `Sentence`. Identity: `get_sent_id()`, `set_sent_id()`, `get_text()`, `set_text()`. Tokens: `tokens()`, `num_tokens()`, `get_token_by_id(id)`, `add_token()`, `remove_token(id | Token*, skip_dependency_validation = false)`, `remove_all_tokens()`. Multiword tokens: `words()`, `num_words()`, `add_word(first, last)`, `remove_word(word, remove_tokens = false)`, `remove_all_words(remove_tokens = false)`. Sentence-level empty nodes: `empty_nodes()`, `empty_node_count()`, `add_empty_node()`, `remove_empty_node(id | Token*)`, `remove_all_empty_nodes()`. Metadata: `metadata()`, `num_metadata_entries()`, `get_metadata(key)`, `set_metadata(key, value = {})`, `set_metadata_from_comment_line(line)`, `unset_metadata(key)`, `remove_all_metadata()`. Owner: `treebank()`, `paragraph()`. State: `empty()`, `clear()`, `validate()`.
- [conllu/document.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/document.hpp): `Document`. Identity: `is_explicit()`, `get_id()`, `set_id(id = std::nullopt)`. Comments: `metadata()`, `num_metadata_entries()`, `get_metadata(key)`, `set_metadata(key, value = {})`, `set_metadata_from_comment_line(line)`, `unset_metadata(key)`, `remove_all_metadata()`. Paragraphs: `paragraphs()`, `num_paragraphs()`, `add_paragraph(id = std::nullopt)`, `remove_paragraph(Paragraph*)`. Sentences: `sentences()`, `num_sentences()`. Structure: `split(Sentence*)`, `merge_next()`. Owner: `treebank()`. State: `empty()`.
- [conllu/paragraph.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/paragraph.hpp): `Paragraph`. Identity: `is_explicit()`, `get_id()`, `set_id(id = std::nullopt)`. Sentences: `sentences()`, `num_sentences()`, `add_sentence(sent_id, text = {})`. Structure: `split(Sentence*)`, `merge_next()`. Owner: `document()`. State: `empty()`.
- [conllu/token.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/token.hpp): `Token` (a token or an empty node) and `TokenId` (`std::uint64_t`). Identity: `get_id()` (for an empty node, the number after the dot), `sentence()`, `is_empty_node()`, `get_parent()` (the owning token; `nullptr` for tokens and for `0.M` nodes), `get_word()`, `is_in_word()`. HEAD: `get_head()`, `set_head(id)`. Fields: `fields()`, `num_fields()`, `get_field_value(pos | name)`, `set_field_value(pos | name, value)`, `unset_field_value(pos | name)`. Empty nodes: `empty_nodes()`, `empty_node_count()`, `add_empty_node()`, `remove_empty_node(id | Token*)`, `remove_all_empty_nodes()`. `validate()`.
- [conllu/word.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/word.hpp): `Word` (a multiword token) and `Word::Range` (inclusive `[first, last]` with `count()`, `contains()`, `overlaps()`, `equals()`, `is_valid()`). Range: `first_id()`, `last_id()`, `set_range()`. Fields: `get_form()`/`set_form()`/`unset_form()`, `get_misc()`/`set_misc()`/`unset_misc()`, `get_typo()`/`set_typo()`/`unset_typo()`. Tokens: `tokens()`, `num_tokens()`, `contains_token(Token*)`, `contains_token_id(id)`. `validate()`.
- [conllu/error.hpp](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/include/conllu/error.hpp): `ErrorCode`, `ErrorCategory`, `get_error_category()`, `make_error_code()`, and the `std::is_error_code_enum` specialization.

## Optional

- [Tests](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/tree/main/tests): GoogleTest suites per module (`tests/<module>/`); configure with `-DBUILD_TESTS=ON` and run `ctest`. They are the most precise reference for edge-case behavior.
- [Bundled treebanks](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/tree/main/tests/.data): UD test sets for German (HDT), English (GUM, LittlePrince), Russian (Taiga), and Turkish (BOUN), used by the tests and the demo.
- [Web demo](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/tree/main/demo): A CoNLL-U viewer compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten (`scripts/demo-web.sh`, `-DBUILD_DEMO=ON`).
- [Single-header build](https://github.com/tugrulgungor/CoNLL-U/blob/main/scripts/amalgamate.py): `python amalgamate.py` (run from `scripts/`) writes `single_header/conllu.hpp`.
